summary.text: At a glance: TELENOR ASA is a public limited company (ASA) in Bærum, working in kabelbasert, satellittbasert og trådløs telekommunikasjon; 369 registered employees and operating revenue NOK 355,000,000 in 2025, down 48% on 2024; website https://www.telenor.no/.

What's new (past 12 months, newest first): 2026-11-12 employee count updated: 369; 2026-10-13 employee count updated: 370; 2026-09-21 auditor registration changed; 2026-09-14 employee count updated: 374; 2026-08-12 employee count updated: 296; 2026-07-15 employee count updated: 297; +8 more.

What it does: Primary industry: 61.100 Kabelbasert, satellittbasert og trådløs telekommunikasjon. Registered purpose: Telekommunikasjonsvirksomhet og annen virksomhet som har sammenheng med dette. Virksomheten kan utøves av selskapet selv, av datterselskaper, eller gjennom deltakelse i andre selskaper eller i samarbeid med andre.
Business address: Snarøyveien 30, 1360 FORNEBU, Norge (BÆRUM municipality).
Size: 369 registered employees; latest filed company accounts (2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31): operating revenue NOK 355,000,000, annual result NOK 11,638,000,000.
People: CEO (daglig leder): Benedicte Schilbred Fasmer; board chair: Jens Petter Olsen; 9 other board members; auditor: DELOITTE AS.
Locations: 3 active sub-units registered (incl. FORNEBU, TROMSØ, TRONDHEIM).
Status: no bankruptcy, liquidation or forced-dissolution flags registered.
Website: https://www.telenor.no/ (as registered, and verified on the site).
Company-owned profiles linked from its website: https://facebook.com/telenornorge, https://instagram.com/telenornorge, https://x.com/TelenorNorge, https://youtube.com/user/TelenorNorway.
Hiring: no active job ads on arbeidsplassen.no (NAV) for this company or its sub-units.
Recent registry activity: 2026-11-12 employee count updated: 369; 2026-10-13 employee count updated: 370; 2026-09-14 employee count updated: 374 (13 events since 2025).
Changes: none since the previous check on 2026-11-13.
Unknown or not published: job postings (none active on NAV).
